subject.title: feat(android): add inline dictation to chat composer

question: Should Android Chat own an on-device inline dictation control beside Voice Note and Talk, with recognizer-unavailable devices showing the proposed unavailable state?
rationale: This PR adds a new user-facing voice-entry mode rather than repairing an established broken contract, and the current thread contains no explicit owner decision on permanent product scope.

options.title: Sponsor on-device dictation
options.body: Confirm the Android-local scope and proceed after a recognizer-enabled proof demonstrates successful draft insertion and owner isolation.

options.title: Keep existing voice entry points
options.body: Decline the new composer mode and retain Voice Note, Talk, and platform keyboard dictation as the supported paths.

recommendation.title: Sponsor on-device dictation
recommendation.body: Confirm the Android-local scope and proceed after a recognizer-enabled proof demonstrates successful draft insertion and owner isolation.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assigned reviewer/landing contact for the current Android feature head and can obtain the needed Android product decision.
